season_weather_time.note: Sun, thunder/rain and moon are explicit celestial/weather evidence.

fauna.note: `மறப்புலி` is explicitly an imagined/frightening verbal device, not evidence of an actual tiger occurrence; it is retained only as source animal imagery.

people_social_roles.note: Hungry speaker/group, singers, patron, child, mother and father are retained as source roles.

relationships.note: Patron-recipient and household parent-child relationships are explicit.

emotion_lived_experience.note: Severe hunger, urgency, child's crying, mother's distress and remembered father are explicit lived experience.

food_subsistence.note: Hunger, ghee-rice, milkless breast, gruel/rice and empty food vessels are explicit subsistence evidence.

clothing_ornaments_adornment.note: Gold vessel prestige material and child's topknot are retained conservatively as adornment/body-presentation evidence.

material_culture_everyday_objects.note: Gold food vessel and household vessels are explicit material culture.

economy.note: Valuable gifts, patron generosity and requested wealth/relief are explicit patronage evidence.

communities_social_groups.note: `பாடுநர் கடும்பு` is retained as a source singer/household group without later reclassification.

family_gender_kinship.note: Child, mother, father and nursing relation are explicit family/gender/kinship evidence.

arts_music_performance.note: Singer-group and praise/fame discourse are retained as performance evidence.

knowledge_technology.note: The mother's household practice of invoking an imagined tiger and showing the moon to the crying child is retained as source-level social/practical knowledge, not as literal fauna occurrence.

values_ethical_concepts.note: Generosity, friendship/fame and the appeal to relieve household suffering are explicit evaluative/value reasoning.

body_health.note: Hunger, gut/body wasting, milkless breast and household distress are explicit body/health evidence.
